faq.heading: Frequently asked
faq.sub: Common questions about translating between English and Japanese.

items.q: Does it write Japanese in kanji and kana, not romaji?
items.a: Yes, translations appear in proper Japanese script, ready to read, hear, or copy.

items.q: Can it translate spoken Japanese back to English?
items.a: Yes — speak Japanese into the mic and get an English translation as text, with audio playback available.

items.q: Does it use polite Japanese or casual speech?
items.a: It aims for natural, appropriately polite phrasing suited to everyday conversations, travel, and casual work chats.
Yes. The service is free for everyone — no subscription and no quota. Sign in with email, Google or Apple only if you want your history attached to an account instead of this browser.

items.q: Do I need a Japanese input method installed?
items.a: No, the app displays kanji and kana automatically — no separate keyboard needed.

items.q: Can I hear how the Japanese translation is pronounced?
items.a: Yes, tap the speaker icon on any translation to hear it read aloud.

finalCta.heading: Start your English to Japanese
